proposal.reason: Main substantive change is in the ext-kernel plugin: adds the new OneShotPush extension AllReduce kernel (BF16, rank-scoped instantiations), wires strategy selection/dispatch, and extends plugin workspace/config lifecycle (new push buffer/phase regions, topology-gated default limits, launch config, and abort/phase handling). These are plugin-provided execution and integration changes, not independent core built-in kernel/tuning/workflow changes.
